rationale: Lokesh brings hands-on ML engineering and real-time data pipeline expertise from Beckman Coulter, while Priyamvada offers 5+ years of experience translating AI and data work into business value at scale—including MLOps and real-time analytics strategy she's identified as game-changers. Both work in data-AI domains with Python, and their complementary skill sets (Lokesh's engineering depth + Priyamvada's architectural and strategy lens) make them natural collaborators for exploring how to operationalize ML systems in enterprise contexts.
intro_message: Lokesh kank, meet Priyamvada Huddar — you both work in ML and real-time data systems, but from different angles: Lokesh builds the pipelines and forecasting engines, and Priyamvada designs how to scale them for business impact; grab coffee to compare notes on production ML.
